title: Installment Charges an Initial TRICARE Prime Payment Settles
content:
**Rule.** The installment charges an initial payment on a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment settles turn on when the application was received:

| Application received | Charges settled |
|---|---|
| after the end of the installment period containing the effective date | every installment charge on the account |
| before the effective date | the installment charge whose coverage period begins on the effective date |
| otherwise | the installment charge posted most recently |

Installment periods are calendar months, calendar quarters or the calendar year, following the enrollment's payment arrangement.

## Worked case (hypothetical, monthly arrangement, effective date 1 March, application received 10 May)

The application came after the end of March, so every installment charge on the account is settled: with three monthly charges of 40.39 on the account, 121.17 in all.

With the application received on 20 February instead, before the effective date, only the charge whose coverage period begins on 1 March is settled.
